notes: A pack groups hub skills with companion files that install outside a skill directory. files maps a hub source path to its project destination. Installing a pack never enables a service or spends money.

catalog-media-tools.summary: Shared catalog search plus local media inspection, frame extraction and OCR.
requires: network access to raw.githubusercontent.com for the first catalog download
ffprobe and ffmpeg for inspect and frame
catalog-media-tools.origin: Recovered 2026-11-27. Byte-identical copies were already distributed to four project repositories; the hub copy is now the reference they are verified against.

motion-runtime.summary: Dependency-free browser runtime for hub motion specifications: plays the JSON through the Web Animations API with right-to-left mirroring, stagger, typewriter and counters.
requires: a browser with the Web Animations API
